answer: An agent economy monitoring saffron crops and greenhouse trellis sensors resists Sybil attacks using memory-hard proof-of-work. To participate, each agent computes sequential memory-hard hashes across fixed memory tables before transmitting a telemetry signal. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of dedicating scarce, high-bandwidth RAM per forged identity. However, this requirement exhausts battery-powered edge devices and fails to stop adversaries with specialized memory hardware.
